title: Long Term Study With B2036-PEG
brief_summary: Primary objective: To investigate the efficacy and safety of Pegvisomant in Japanese patients with acromegaly.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with acromegaly who have received at least one dose of B2036-PEG in the preceding study (A6291009).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Switching to other therapeutic methods for acromegaly
